description: This file provides a Python 2.4 source code implementation of an interface class 'AdbInterface' for communicating with Android devices via the Android Debug Bridge (adb). It contains methods for executing commands, transferring files, starting instrumentation tests, managing device state, and querying device properties, all tailored to facilitate automated testing and device management.

classes.name: AdbInterface
classes.description: Helper class for communicating with Android device via adb, encapsulating various device management and testing functionalities.

methods.name: SetDeviceTarget(self)
methods.description: Direct all future commands to the only connected USB device.

methods.description: Direct all future commands to Android target with the given serial.

methods.description: Send a general adb command and return its output.

methods.description: Send an adb shell command and return its output.

methods.description: Dump adb bugreport to a specified file.

methods.description: Push a file onto the device.

methods.description: Pull a file from the device to the host.
